task_metadata.research_topic: low-step time discretization schedules for diffusion bridge implicit models
task_metadata.research_question: Design a monotone time schedule for diffusion bridge implicit models that improves low-step FID over standard schedules on paired image translation and inpainting benchmarks.
notes: task_description.md frames the task as NFE=5, but the current test scripts export nfe=3.

tests.label: edges2handbags
tests.notes: Paired edges-to-handbags translation benchmark from pix2pix, evaluated with FID and reused by diffusion-bridge work.

tests.label: DIODE
tests.notes: Dense depth-conditioned translation benchmark over the DIODE dataset, scored by FID.

tests.label: Imagenet
tests.notes: ImageNet center-inpainting evaluation, linked to the ImageNet dataset, diffusion inpainting literature, and FID.

baselines.name: karras
baselines.notes: The edit explicitly cites Karras et al. (2022) and implements the EDM power-law sigma schedule with rho=7.

baselines.name: uniform
baselines.notes: Generic linear interpolation in sigma/time; I did not find a single canonical paper that exactly defines this baseline in the same form.

baselines.name: cosine
baselines.notes: The edit file explicitly maps this baseline to Nichol and Dhariwal's cosine schedule.

baselines.name: loglinear
baselines.notes: Geometric spacing in log-sigma space is a common discretization heuristic, but I did not locate a single exact source paper for this baseline as implemented here.

papers.title: Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models
papers.relevance: Introduces the EDM power-law sigma schedule used by the karras baseline and is directly relevant to low-step sampler design.

papers.title: Improved Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.relevance: Introduces the cosine noise schedule that this task's cosine baseline is derived from.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.relevance: Foundational DDPM paper for diffusion-based sampling and discretization choices underlying later schedule work.

papers.title: DPM-Solver: A Fast ODE Solver for Diffusion Probabilistic Model Sampling in Around 10 Steps
papers.relevance: Highly relevant fast-sampling reference for designing better schedules when the evaluation budget is only a few function evaluations.

papers.title: Progressive Distillation for Fast Sampling of Diffusion Models
papers.relevance: Direct evidence that low-step diffusion performance is a first-class research problem; useful related work for the task's NFE-constrained objective.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models
papers.relevance: Core diffusion-bridge reference for the task family; directly studies paired endpoint diffusion bridges for image translation.

papers.title: Diffusion Bridge Implicit Models
papers.relevance: Most directly aligned paper for the package family used by this task; studies fast sampling of diffusion bridge implicit models.
